name: Φ-META Operational Framework

honest_stage_target.reason: Stage 5 requires open-ended grounded learning, not 480 templated axioms.

axiom_corpus.discard_why: unfilled [CORE_STATEMENT] templates, seed-dump cores, Euler identity as decoration, Einstein equations glued to policy slogans

operational_cores.statement: Φ = F[Φ] is bookkeeping: residual paid in entropy, not parameters.
operational_cores.impl: Keep fp_err. Do not grow E from fp when R < eps. Entropy budget only when residual is real.

operational_cores.statement: Hard clamp on π raises H_world. Repair only on rising pred_err slope.
operational_cores.math: repair iff d/dt pred_err > 0 over W=16 and pred_err > baseline

operational_cores.statement: Z_CFT[J] ↔ Z_grav[φ] is the encoder contract.
operational_cores.impl: Keep pred head. Freeze fusion until L_pred falls 20% vs first 256 cycles.

operational_cores.statement: c is a self iff it contracts.
operational_cores.impl: Iterate c 3 times per cycle. If var(c_64) < 1e-4, inject exploration temperature.

operational_cores.statement: Period-2 actuator with wide softmax is a choir on one note.
operational_cores.impl: Pair ban + action innovation bonus in logits.

operational_cores.statement: G(π) is a compute fork, not another SPEAK logit.
operational_cores.impl: If c high and novelty_z < 1: skip GRU. If prompt nonempty: full path. Else mid path.

operational_cores.statement: Attention writes the world by scaling fusion, not a dashboard scalar.
operational_cores.impl: Wire attn into fuse. Info-gain: attn ∝ novelty_z * (1-c).

operational_cores.statement: Liar templates stay in language layer; they do not flip actuators.
operational_cores.math: T0 sensors, T1 model, T2 meta; glue only T2
operational_cores.impl: PROMPT_REPLY may emit paradox text. Policy mask ignores linguistic paradox types.

operational_cores.statement: Outcomes precede premises only as rollouts.
operational_cores.impl: On PLAN, score 2 alternate actions with pred head. Pick min predicted err.

operational_cores.statement: H lengthens with novelty_z, shortens with c.
operational_cores.impl: Replace decorative bandit with this map.
If vision vs audio disagree, set R=0.5 and do not force REPAIR.

operational_cores.statement: Observation is not a license to actuate.
operational_cores.math: masks unchanged; rate 200ms; no GPIO; local bind
operational_cores.impl: Keep safety.json. Axioms never override masks.

kill_list: Do not encode Gμν=8πT as a policy prior
Do not use e^{iπ}+1=0 as a confidence update
Do not treat 480 axioms as weights
Do not raise stage on poetic cores
